integrity: Self-contained proof and two separately implemented finite verification programs; finite tests support, but do not establish, universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Exact arbitrary erasure formula is restricted to the top support layer; entire polynomial is determined only for at most three deleted phases. Binary one-saturation theory and the base independent-column criterion are credited as existing results. No independent audit or absolute publication-priority certification.
title: Triple-erasure anisotropy in cyclic maximum-length binary sequences
